# infoblox_federated_block (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox FederatedBlock from the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve Federated Blocks filtered by an attribute
data "infoblox_federated_block" "get_federated_block_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    comment = "Example Federated Block created through Terraform"
  }
}

// Retrieve Federated Blocks filtered by tag
data "infoblox_federated_block" "get_federated_block_using_tag_filters" {
  tag_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}

// NOTE: An unfiltered "retrieve all" data source is intentionally omitted here. The
// underlying API's List endpoint returns IPv6 utilization_v6 values in a shape the current
// SDK cannot unmarshal, so a grid with any pre-existing IPv6 Federated Blocks will cause an
// unfiltered list/datasource call to fail with a JSON unmarshal error. Always scope
// FederatedBlock data sources with filters or tag_filters until that SDK issue is fixed.
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `limit` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for UDDI backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. Only applicable for UDDI backend.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi))
- `update_trigger` (String) An arbitrary value used to trigger an update. Not sent to the API. Change it when Terraform reports no infrastructure changes.

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The address field in form “a.b.c.d/n” where the “/n” may be omitted. In this case, the CIDR value must be defined in the _cidr_ field. When reading, the _address_ field is always in the form “a.b.c.d”.
- `allocation_v4` (Attributes) The __Allocation__ tracks the distribution of Federated Blocks within each of the supported objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--allocation_v4))
- `cidr` (Number) The CIDR of the federated block. This is required, if _address_ does not specify it in its input.
- `comment` (String) The description for the federated block. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `dynamic_allocation` (Attributes) Dynamically allocate the next available federated block from a parent scope. Mutually exclusive with the static "address" field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--dynamic_allocation))
- `federated_pool_id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `federated_realm` (String) The resource identifier.
- `metadata` (Map of String) The metadata for the federated block in JSON format.
- `name` (String) The name of the federated block. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `network_compliance` (Attributes) The __NetworkCompliance__ represents the network compliance of federated pool and federated block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--network_compliance))
- `network_compliant` (Boolean) Indicates if this block is compliant with its parent's network compliance policy. When false, a trouble dot should be displayed in the UI to indicate non-compliance.
- `parent` (String) The resource identifier.
- `protocol` (String) The type of protocol of federated block (_ip4_ or _ip6_).
- `region` (String) The region where the federated block is located.
- `state` (String) The state of the federated block.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the federated block in JSON format.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
- `utilization` (Number) The percentage of Federated Block utilization.
- `utilization_v6` (Attributes) The __UtilizationV6__ represents IPv6 utilization metrics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--utilization_v6))

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi--allocation_v4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi.allocation_v4`

Read-Only:

- `allocated` (Number) Percent of total space allocated.
- `delegated` (Number) Percent of total space delegated.
- `forward_looking_delegation` (Number) Percent of total space in forward looking delegation blocks.
- `overlapping` (Number) Percent of total space in overlapping blocks.
- `reserved` (Number) Percent of total space reserved.


<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi--dynamic_allocation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi.dynamic_allocation`

Read-Only:

- `next_available_id` (String) The resource identifier of the parent Federated Block or Federated Pool under which the next available federated block should be allocated. Allocating directly from a Federated Pool is only supported for AWS-backed pools.


<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi--network_compliance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi.network_compliance`

Read-Only:

- `default_netmask_length` (Number) The default netmask length used when allocating child blocks or pools.
- `maximum_netmask_length` (Number) The maximum netmask length for allocating child blocks or pools.
- `minimum_netmask_length` (Number) The minimum netmask length for allocating child blocks or pools.


<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi--utilization_v6"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi.utilization_v6`

Read-Only:

- `total` (String) Total IPv6 addresses.
- `used` (String) Used IPv6 addresses.
